Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class SharedGameTestSupport.EventRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.SharedGameTestSupport.EventRecorder
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.GameEventListener
Enclosing class:
SharedGameTestSupport
static final class SharedGameTestSupport.EventRecorder extends Object implements net.minecraft.world.level.gameevent.GameEventListener
Records the game events emitted at one block. The listener is attached to the level only while during(java.util.function.Supplier<R>) runs.
